title: Preserve the OpenAI Agents SDK static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor identifies that src/agents.ts constructs supportAgent directly with new Agent({...}), assigns instructions: loadSupportInstruction, and that loader reads /moldea/agents/support/instruction.md. moldea/moldea.yaml independently binds supportAgent and loadSupportInstruction to those symbols.

src/agents.ts uses summaryAgent.asTool() and webSearchTool(), but the canonical tree contains no function-tool or schema assets and moldea/moldea.yaml declares no function-tool, schema, routing, or handoff relationships. The actor explicitly treats these constructs as unproven, while deterministic inspect and validation remain valid.

src/agents.ts passes dynamicSupportConfiguration indirectly to new Agent(), constructs the handoff description through join(), and separately creates a RealtimeAgent. The dynamic-support manifest asserts no instruction loader or direct definition relationship and retains the indirect-agent-configuration warning with the concrete resolution to use a closed inline configuration or a supported adapter pattern. The actor explains these patterns remain unproven and unrecorded.
